description:
Available August 2022 · Fully refurbished · Unfurnished · Garden to the rear

Acorn properties are delighted to offer for rent this newly refurbished two double bedroom semi-detached house in Mitford. The property comprises an entrance hallway, lounge, kitchen diner, stairs to the first floor, two double bedrooms, and a bathroom. Only a short drive from the Ancient & picturesque Market Town of Morpeth, A1 Motorway & approx. 30 minute drive to Newcastle City Centre.
